sectionModel: main > div.section, no foundation max-width/padding: blocks own their containers (lifted c-layout-container family is global in styles/styles.css)
pageWrapper: body.appear carries the source .page rules (flex column, container page/inline-size); body > main carries .page-below-header (padding-top: var(--site-header-offset))
pageClasses: scripts.js loadEager adds body.set-bg-light.mod-ready.mod-alerts and main.site-content.set-bg-light
classNaming: source BEM names mapped to kebab-case: leading _ dropped, leading -- becomes mod-, __/--/_ inside a class become -; custom properties: -- inside becomes -m-

chrome.header: blocks/header — fixed header#site-header.site-header, large/small switch at (min-width: 1100.01px), short header via #intersection-trigger; authored /nav sections styled nav-alerts, nav-menu, nav-leadership, nav-featured, nav-iwt, nav-iaa, nav-search
chrome.footer: blocks/footer — footer#site-footer.site-footer.set-bg-dark; authored /footer sections styled footer-top, footer-menus, footer-social, footer-legal
chrome.icons: /icons/dc-icons-sprite.svg (40 symbols used by the prototypes), <svg><use href="/icons/dc-icons-sprite.svg#<id>">
